verdict.rationale: Vue's official testing guide says components and composables can render headlessly under Vitest, which is maintained by Vue/Vite team members, with the first-party @vue/test-utils. It also says test runs typically happen in CI/CD pipelines. Coverage is limited to testing workflows, and the explicit headless-in-CI browser runs rely on third-party runners such as Playwright. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on CI pipeline setup, documented headless automation beyond testing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Vitest for components or composables that render headlessly (e.g. the useFavicon function in VueUse). Components and DOM can be tested using @vue/test-utils.
Typically, this is only done in continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
We recommend using @vue/test-utils for testing components in applications.
